{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
# First, verify there are no non-numeric characters besides commas
assert not data['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9,.]', na=False).any(), "Unexpected non-numeric characters in revenue"

# Replace commas with empty string and convert to float
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[~(data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Also remove refunded orders
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Final dataset
print("Final dataset shape:", data_clean.shape)"}
